learner_operation: Eliminate x (possibly swap rows); set the remaining affine y coefficient to zero; inspect the residual constant to distinguish contradiction from a redundant equation, then choose the resulting k.

fixed_features.feature: One unique k and two variables
fixed_features.justification: All 18 source cases solve this finite parameter-identification task, not inequality/set entry or general classification.

fixed_features.feature: Inconsistency for simpler band; dependence in hard source band
fixed_features.justification: All labelled moderate sources are inconsistency and all hard sources are dependence; easy has no directly captured question.

answer_roles.observed: Signed nonzero values vary; zero is universally excluded by t/-t collisions in default banks.

answer_roles.observed: Easy bank always puts correct choice at signed extreme: |t|>|b|.

counterfactuals.change: Hold a,b,c,d,u,e and seed fixed, change v=3 to v=1.
counterfactuals.expected: k changes from 1 to 3, elimination and grading follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Printed prompt, matrices and conclusion change coherently; native grader accepts new correct answer and rejects old k=1 (present as distractor). Actual UI rendered both.

counterfactuals.change: Hold coefficients and seed fixed, change second RHS 3 to 4.
counterfactuals.expected: k remains 1; contradiction residual changes from 1 to 2.
counterfactuals.observed: Same correct equation, updated prompt and solution constant; native grader accepts unchanged key and rejects wrong choices. Actual UI rendered pair.
counterfactuals.justification: Both residuals nonzero; their magnitudes do not change the singular parameter.

counterfactuals.change: Change only v=3 to v=4 at same shifted moderate parameters.
counterfactuals.expected: A valid k=0 instance with five distinct choices and matching solution.
counterfactuals.observed: Complete bank collision raises ValueError; no record reaches renderer or grader.
counterfactuals.justification: 0 is not prohibited by elimination; it yields 0=1. Its exclusion is imposed by distractor recipes.

shortcut_probes.cue: Signs only of the first-row y coefficient and second-row x coefficient; extremal answer position in numeric order
shortcut_probes.strategy: If signs agree choose largest positive option, otherwise choose most negative option; ignore all coefficient magnitudes and constants.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Five-choice blind baseline is 1/5. Complete success follows from fixed bank {t,-t,b,-b,0}, a=u=1, |d|>1, so |t|>|b|. This computes no product magnitude or zero-row criterion. The source bank q-32245 has a same-method counterexample (correct -2, distractor -4), showing this is incidental to the bank construction.
